findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu0.15.
findings.remediation: Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.

findings.title: Web service is reachable
findings.evidence: Port 80/tcp is open and identified as nginx 1.18.0 on 10.129.7.33.
findings.remediation: Confirm the web service is intended to be reachable and keep the web server patched.

findings.title: Limited attack surface observed
findings.evidence: Only SSH and HTTP were found open in this scan.
findings.remediation: Continue monitoring for unexpected service exposure and remove any services that are not required.
